trap.label: too/enough
trap.why: Em português 'suficientemente grande' vem antes ou depois; em inglês enough vem depois do adjetivo.

mcq.q: The tea is ___ hot to drink.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com enough: “She is not tall.” (to reach)
rewrite.answer: She isn't tall enough to reach.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com too: “It is very hot to eat.”
rewrite.answer: It is too hot to eat.
